### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **1** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 021abd44885c92b318376b2f979027a23319826a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #34306 (#34296) · 2026-11-16T05:46Z

Head-sha: `debc73e485eada6fd77e3c9f31fe3aa01000a510` · report 6908021748 · claim 6907437626

- **Form:** draft → `main`. The body and the changeset carry `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` and `Fixes #34296`. No export, field, flag or schema key changes: the diff is card data (`docs/qa/scenarios/{crm_account_with_contacts,invoice_with_line_items,project_with_tasks}.json`), the tests that count those cards (`test/library.test.ts`, `test/refusals.test.ts`, `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, `test/export/exporter.test.ts`), a one-line package README fix and the changeset. Contract review not required (Clause-② no).
- **Diff read (seat), against the order:** every control card text (`prompt.short`, `prompt.detailed`, `iterate.change`, each question's and operation's `ask`) carries `zh` beside `en`, so `--lang zh` runs all three; each card adds three unanswerable questions, each beside an answerable twin of the same shape over seeded data; each card has at least one `avg`, `max` and `min` truth computed by the loader from the seed; `crm_account_with_contacts` seeds a new number field `account.employees`, stated in its data contract. Counts: crm 8 → 14 questions, invoice 9 → 14, project 8 → 13; seeds, personas and operations otherwise unchanged. The four test files only re-count the fixtures and pin the new truths; the extra test files beyond `library.test.ts` were accepted in the thread.
- **Gates:** check-runs at this head: 51 — 35 success, 16 skipped, 0 other (read this act); `mergeable_state` clean. Local (thread): package tests green, derived gates all exit 0.
- **Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff:** the summary line; the `--lang zh` paragraph; the unanswerable-with-twin paragraph (names match the card JSON); the `account.employees` sentence; the counts paragraph (matches the loader's count and the orchestrate test's persona-turn totals). All hold. The changeset warns that a scorecard from before this change does not compare with one after it.
- **Landing:** K = 8 (`git rev-list --count --first-parent 021abd44..origin/main`, PRBASE = Test Core's printed `Affected-set diff base`); `git merge-tree` against current main (`22bcc769`) is clean; no locale pack. Sibling note: PR #34312 (#34293) conflicts with this PR in `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` (both re-count persona turns); that thread merges main and re-counts after this lands. Landed on the maintainer's standing word 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30 14:20Z, spec seat 2 thread): `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this stroke.
